channel.title: CelebrityLooks
channel.description: What celebrities wear, who made it and where to shop.

item.title: Zendaya in Louis Vuitton at the Paris Fashion Week SS27
item.description: Zendaya rewore the custom ivory ruffled lace Louis Vuitton bolero jacket from The Odyssey Paris premiere with a white cropped tank, low-rise jeans, white pointed pumps and Cartier jewelry.

item.title: Kristen Wiig in Chanel at the Paris Fashion Week SS27
item.description: Wiig wore a fitted strapless black tweed Chanel minidress with white trim and a double-C emblem, red heels with black toe caps, and carried a black jacket with white edging.

item.title: Zendaya in Prada at the Emmys 2026
item.description: Zendaya wore a custom silver Prada gown inspired by the spring 2010 collection, with a plunging neckline, sheer tulle underlayer, strands of crystals at the waist and a slight train, plus Mikimoto diamond-and-pearl earrings.

item.title: Selena Gomez in Louis Vuitton at the Emmys 2026
item.description: Gomez wore a strapless gold Louis Vuitton mermaid gown covered in metallic beads with a circular beaded detail at the waist, with Tiffany & Co. jewelry.

item.title: Nicole Kidman in Chanel at the Emmys 2026
item.description: Kidman wore a white Chanel wool crepe bustier gown embellished with 46 handmade flowers in silk crepe, silk organza and raffia, with Chanel shoes and jewelry.

item.title: Elle Fanning in Ralph Lauren at the Emmys 2026
item.description: Fanning wore a made-to-order sage-green Ralph Lauren gown in embroidered silk chiffon with glass beads and an open back, with Cartier drop earrings.

item.title: Laura Dern in Prada at the Venice Film Festival 2026
item.description: Dern wore a pastel pink Prada dress with cap sleeves and a tea-length skirt, with a Cartier necklace.

item.title: Claire Foy in Bottega Veneta at the Venice Film Festival 2026
item.description: Foy wore a custom tomato-red satin column gown by Bottega Veneta with burgundy leather opera gloves and Swarovski jewelry.

item.title: Amal Clooney in Tom Ford at the Venice Film Festival 2026
item.description: Clooney wore a custom ruched Tom Ford dress by Haider Ackermann, coordinated with George Clooney's tuxedo, with Cartier earrings.

item.title: Bella Hadid in Schiaparelli at the Cannes Film Festival 2026
item.description: Hadid arrived in a semi-sheer trompe-l'oeil lace Schiaparelli gown with a lace-up back and ruffled train, reported as an homage to Jane Birkin.

item.title: Kristen Stewart in Chanel at the Cannes Film Festival 2026
item.description: Stewart wore a sequin Chanel gown from the house's Fall 2026 runway collection.

item.title: Demi Moore in Jacquemus at the Cannes Film Festival 2026
item.description: As a festival juror, Moore wore a custom white strapless sequined Jacquemus gown with a peplum to the opening ceremony, with Chopard jewelry.

item.title: Sabrina Carpenter in Dior at the Met Gala 2026
item.description: Custom Dior by Jonathan Anderson: a sheer tulle gown with a slit, wrapped in rhinestone film strips from Billy Wilder's 1954 film Sabrina, with embroidered fringed cuffs, a jeweled headpiece and black stretch-tulle gloves.

item.title: Rihanna in Maison Margiela at the Met Gala 2026
item.description: Maison Margiela couture by Glenn Martens: a gold metallic column skirt that wraps the legs and rises into an oval frame around the torso, over a jewel-encrusted turtleneck top. Forty metal pin curls from Jennifer Behr covered her hair.

item.title: Nicole Kidman in Chanel at the Met Gala 2026
item.description: Floor-length red Chanel column gown covered in paillettes, with a high neckline, long sleeves, feathers at the waist and cuffs, and a train. She wore Chanel High Jewellery diamond earrings and ring and an archival 1982 Omega Constellation Manhattan watch.

item.title: Doechii in Marc Jacobs at the Met Gala 2026
item.description: Burgundy Marc Jacobs wrap dress with a matching Marc Jacobs headpiece, chosen with stylist Sam Woolf, worn with gold jewelry set with gems.

item.title: Colman Domingo in Valentino at the Met Gala 2026
item.description: Custom Valentino by Alessandro Michele: a pleated chiffon jacket with a colour-blocked woven pattern based on the house's harlequin motif, worn with black wool bootcut trousers with red bead- and sequin-embroidered side bands, plus an Omega Constellation watch.

item.title: Teyana Taylor in Chanel at the Oscars 2026
item.description: A black Chanel gown with a sheer bodice panel, black and white pearls and crystals along the top, and a figure-hugging mermaid skirt layered with black and white feathers. She wore Tiffany & Co. platinum and diamond jewelry.

item.title: Jessie Buckley in Chanel at the Oscars 2026
item.description: A Chanel gown by Matthieu Blazy with red silk satin wrapped around the torso and ballet-pink chiffon gathered at the waist falling into a long train. She wore a Chanel High Jewelry diamond necklace, ring and earrings in 18-karat white gold.

item.title: Emma Stone in Louis Vuitton at the Oscars 2026
item.description: A custom shimmering silver Louis Vuitton gown with cap sleeves, a low neckline and a plunging open back, covered in tens of thousands of pearlescent beads.

item.title: Elle Fanning in Givenchy at the Oscars 2026
item.description: A custom Givenchy tulle ballgown by Sarah Burton with a strapless hourglass bodice, a double train and lavender wisteria petals running from the chest to the hem. She wore a 1903 Cartier leaf-motif diamond necklace.

item.title: Demi Moore in Gucci at the Oscars 2026
item.description: A custom Gucci gown covered in iridescent feathers with metallic green undertones and a plumed train, worn with emerald jewelry.

item.title: Teyana Taylor in Tom Ford at the Grammys 2026
item.description: A sparkling bronze Tom Ford gown with asymmetrical cut-outs at the torso, a plunging neckline and a halter-style collar. She wore Tiffany & Co. HardWear link earrings and a wrap lariat necklace.

item.title: Sabrina Carpenter in Valentino at the Grammys 2026
item.description: A custom white floor-length Valentino gown by Alessandro Michele with a beaded floral bodice over a nude underlay, short cape-like sleeves and semi-sheer tiered ruffles with pearl polka dots.

item.title: Olivia Dean in Chanel at the Grammys 2026
item.description: A custom Chanel ballgown by Matthieu Blazy with a black sequinned bodice, a drop waist and a white pleated skirt with feather details and a high-low hem that flowed into a bustled train.

item.title: Doechii in Roberto Cavalli at the Grammys 2026
item.description: A custom Roberto Cavalli look with a purple silk duchesse corset skirt with bustles, ruching and a long train, worn with a sheer criss-cross laced top. She wore Chopard purple flower drop earrings and a matching ring.

item.title: Teyana Taylor in Schiaparelli at the Golden Globes 2026
item.description: A custom black Schiaparelli Haute Couture gown by Daniel Roseberry with cut-outs, an asymmetrical halter-style neckline and a scarf detail trailing behind like a train. The open back featured a silver rhinestone detail with a crystal bow.

item.title: Selena Gomez in Chanel at the Golden Globes 2026
item.description: A custom black velvet Chanel bustier gown designed by Matthieu Blazy, with white flowers at the neckline made of feathers, silk chiffon and silk organza. She wore Chanel High Jewelry earrings.

item.title: Jessie Buckley in Dior at the Golden Globes 2026
item.description: A strapless ice-blue Dior gown with delicate floral details, worn with matching heels.

item.title: Emma Stone in Louis Vuitton at the Golden Globes 2026
item.description: A butter-yellow Louis Vuitton two-piece: a cropped sleeveless tank top and a skirt with beaded fringe.

item.title: Ariana Grande in Vivienne Westwood at the Golden Globes 2026
item.description: A black off-the-shoulder Vivienne Westwood Couture ballgown with a corseted foundation covered in crimped chiffon, a voluminous bustled skirt and a bubble-like train. She wore Swarovski diamond studs and a matching necklace.

item.title: Zendaya in Louis Vuitton at the Met Gala 2025
item.description: Custom Louis Vuitton three-piece suit by Pharrell Williams in white, with a sculpted blazer, waistcoat, shirt and tie and high-rise flared trousers, worn with a matching hat at a slant. Bulgari supplied the jewelry, and the look was modelled on Bianca Jagger's 1971 wedding suit.

item.title: Teyana Taylor in Marc Jacobs at the Met Gala 2025
item.description: Custom ensemble by Marc Jacobs with costume designer Ruth E. Carter honouring Harlem: wide fitted trousers, a cape inscribed with a reference to the Harlem Renaissance, a feathered cap over a durag, long chains, gloves, brooches, platform heels and a cane.

item.title: Sabrina Carpenter in Louis Vuitton at the Met Gala 2025
item.description: Custom Louis Vuitton look by Pharrell Williams: a tailored jacquard bodysuit worn without trousers under a cropped suit jacket with a long suit-tail train at the back. She wore burgundy platform shoes, a diamond anklet and a diamond chain clipped to a white collar.

item.title: Rihanna in Marc Jacobs at the Met Gala 2025
item.description: Marc Jacobs look in black and grey: a black cropped tuxedo jacket over a striped grey corseted bodice, a black pinstripe wool coat tied at the back to work as a slit skirt, a top hat, and a polka-dot necktie and pocket square. Two-tone heels and diamond brooches completed it.

item.title: Lewis Hamilton in Wales Bonner at the Met Gala 2025
item.description: Ivory tailoring by Grace Wales Bonner with a short jacket with coattails and high-rise trousers with a tuxedo stripe, a white bow tie, and an embroidered ivory sash lined with cowrie shells. He wore a Stephen Jones beret and baobab-inspired brooches made by Wales Bonner with SNOW Diamonds.

item.title: Doechii in Louis Vuitton at the Met Gala 2025
item.description: Louis Vuitton look made with Pharrell Williams: a strong-shouldered suit coat printed all over with the monogram and a small cape at the back, knee-length Damier check shorts, a white button-down with a pussy-bow ribbon, a micro Speedy bag and burgundy puddle boots.

item.title: Colman Domingo in Valentino at the Met Gala 2025
item.description: Custom Valentino by Alessandro Michele: a pleated royal blue robe with a sequined gold cape, worn over a suit with grey trousers, a white vest and a polka-dot scarf, plus a crystal teardrop necklace and a brooch.
